title: Test stale task sync setup intent after HEAD moves
outcome: Test stale task sync setup intent after HEAD moves
acceptance: An owned fixture prepares an intent, commits an unrelated change, then proves preparation refuses the stale HEAD basis while preserving original intent bytes; regression fails if HEAD is removed from the compared basis

completion.summary:
Landed 000d788 on master (test-only). New tests/task_sync_setup_cli.rs::setup_refuses_an_intent_whose_head_an_unrelated_commit_moved_and_keeps_its_bytes:
- an owned fixture prepares an intent whose recorded head is the pre-commit HEAD;
- it commits only an unrelated file, so HEAD is the only basis field that moves;
- it proves preparation refuses with the existing-intent message while the intent and lock bytes stay unchanged, no pending file is left and no database is created.
It FAILED ("unexpected success") with HEAD removed from the intent.rs comparison and passes with it.
